news.title: Toddler’s death suspected as overdose; parents charged with murder

news.title: ‘He was supposed to be coming home’: Family demands answers in jail death
news.summary: The family of David Addo Wright demands answers after he was fatally stabbed in the DeKalb County Jail shortly after booking.

news.title: 'Is this about the girl?': Man convicted of Acworth attempted rape
news.summary: A Cherokee County jury convicted Sedric Charles Williams of attempted rape and sexual battery following a four-day trial in Canton.

news.title: Motorcyclist killed in Dunwoody crash on Tilly Mill Road, police say
news.summary: A 21-year-old man was killed in a motorcycle crash on Tilly Mill Road in Dunwoody on Thursday afternoon, according to police.

news.title: Convicted felon facing murder, arson charges after Atlanta apartment fire

news.title: 'Painful moment,' attorney says, as Florida deputy found not guilty in 2024 shooting of US airman from metro Atlanta

news.title: Fourth suspect arrested in April homicide on Donald Lee Hollowell Pkwy.

news.title: Cherokee deputy fired, accused of using fake Facebook to target individual

news.title: Stone Mountain man pleads guilty to murder in Lilburn shooting
news.summary: A 64-year-old Stone Mountain man will spend the rest of his life in prison after pleading guilty to killing his former sister-in-law and shooting her brother during a dispute at a Lilburn business.

news.title: Father says system failed his 24-year-old son who died after being "violently killed" at DeKalb County Jail

news.title: Children sue after guard acquitted in fatal Atlanta senior housing stabbing

news.title: Fifth suspect arrested in Atlanta bartender’s killing
news.summary: Jacob Benjamin Wilson, 30, was arrested Wednesday on charges of concealing a death and tampering with evidence in the Jamal Parker case.

news.title: DeKalb announces Blackhall lawsuit, South Fulton has new chief

news.title: Family demands answers after man killed in DeKalb County jail
news.summary: The family of a 24-year-old man who died in the DeKalb County Jail plans to speak publicly Friday for the first time since his death.

news.title: Video: Robbery suspects steal from Atlanta gas station; police seek tips on identities
